name: TM Floating Multi-Chat Buttons
author: Tim Sayr

sections.description:
TM Buttons is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance floating multi-chat contact widget engineered specifically for modern WordPress sites. Empower your visitors to initiate live conversations instantly across 7 distinct communication channels under absolute local server control.

Why TM Buttons Stands Out

Unlike over 500 common social media button plug-ins that heavily rely on monolithic external JavaScript frameworks, third-party iframe containers, or remote telemetry tracking servers, TM Buttons is written from scratch with a strict focus on data isolation, clean code, and speed.

  • 0% External Scripts & 100% GDPR Compliant: The entire core executes without downloading remote assets, third-party code injections, or external tracking cookies. Your user data remains fully local, private, and secure.
  • Zero Performance Impact: Hand-coded in pure, fast Vanilla JS with a footprints weight of less than 3 KB. All communication buttons leverage highly optimized native inline vector SVG geometry, ensuring an absolute zero-score drag footprint on Google PageSpeed Insights.
  • The Max Messenger Integration: Out-of-the-box native structural optimization support layer specifically tailored for stable alternative communications channels without any sudden connection drops or VPN blockages.

Supported Native Channels

  • WhatsApp – Seamless one-click redirection to start instant messaging threads.
  • Telegram – Open direct end-to-end encrypted chat streams with clients.
  • Max Messenger – Embedded stable communication layouts with zero connection drops.
  • Phone Calls – Automated trigger handlers to initialize local device dialers.
  • Email Messages – Safe mail hooks that pre-fill the company receiver address field.
  • Viber – Direct integration hooks for additional community messaging tools.
  • WeChat – Complete cross-border optimization interface for global target markets.

Upgrade to Pro

If you need advanced business features, consider upgrading to “TM Buttons Pro”:
* Built-in Click Analytics: Track conversion rates natively in real-time inside your WordPress dashboard with 1-click AJAX reset.
* Custom Icons Uploader: Replace standard messenger graphics by uploading your own unique images, vectors, or brand logos using the native WordPress Media Library.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘tm-floating-multi-chat-buttons’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress Admin Panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the independent “TM Buttons” standalone menu in your admin dashboard sidebar to configure your messenger links and layout preferences.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

Absolutely not. TM Buttons uses pure CSS for animations and lightweight inline vector SVGs instead of heavy image files, ensuring top-tier Google PageSpeed scores.

Do I need to enter technical prefixes like “tel:” for the phone field?

No! The plugin features smart prefixing. Just type your clean phone number or email address, and the script handles the technical integration automatically.
